note: Summer 2026, every programme except Law; signed by the Registrar 7 Dec 2025. The first row is printed "Orientation and commencement of classes of Spring – 2026" on 6 May 2026; it is Summer 2026's (the Spring 2026 calendar ends with "Orientation and commencement of classes of Summer – 2026" on 6 May), and is recorded so. Club, wellbeing, census, parents' and research-showcase weeks and staff deadlines are left out. classes-pause is the last class before the mid-term, not the end of teaching.
